PROGRAM return review

TYPE ReturnStatus is "new" | "approved" | "needs_review"

RECORD ReturnRequest
  days_since_purchase: integer

RECORD ReturnDecision
  status: ReturnStatus
  reason: "new" | "within_window" | "outside_window"

REQUEST review return
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  OUTPUT decision is ReturnDecision

  THEN decision.status != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO approve return on day 30
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 30

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status = "approved"
  AND decision.reason = "within_window"

SCENARIO require review on day 31
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 31

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status = "needs_review"
  AND decision.reason = "outside_window"

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

RULE customer outage is urgent
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage == true
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
  AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

RULE critical severity is urgent
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
  AND incident.severity == "critical"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
  AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

RULE degraded service needs review
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
  AND incident.severity == "degraded"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "review"
  AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

RULE normal service is routine
  GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
  AND incident.severity == "normal"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "routine"
  AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over critical severity
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: true
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
  AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO critical severity without outage is urgent
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "critical"
    customer_outage: false
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
  AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO degraded service without outage needs review
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "degraded"
    customer_outage: false
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "review"
  AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO normal service without outage is routine
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
    severity: "normal"
    customer_outage: false
  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"
  WHEN triage incident into decision
  THEN decision.priority == "routine"
  AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

SCENARIO fulfill every requested unit when stock is sufficient
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 5

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "fulfilled"
    reserved_units: 5
    backordered_units: 0

SCENARIO partially fulfill an order when some stock exists
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 2

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "partial"
    reserved_units: 2
    backordered_units: 3

SCENARIO backorder every requested unit when no stock exists
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest
    requested_units: 5
    available_units: 0

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "backordered"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

RULE unfunded cohort wins first
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == false
  THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason = "unfunded_cohort"

RULE previous funding wins next
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == true
  THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
  AND decision.reason = "previously_funded"

RULE eligible institution is funded
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == true
  THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
  AND decision.reason = "eligible"

RULE ineligible institution is not funded
  WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == false
  THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason = "ineligible_institution"

SCENARIO unfunded cohort outranks previous funding and eligibility
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: false
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: true

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason == "unfunded_cohort"

SCENARIO previous funding outranks institution ineligibility
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: false

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
  AND decision.reason == "previously_funded"

SCENARIO eligible institution is funded when earlier reasons do not apply
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: true

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
  AND decision.reason == "eligible"

SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded when earlier reasons do not apply
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: false

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason == "ineligible_institution"

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  THEN release.level != "new"

RULE breaking changes produce major releases
  GIVEN commit.breaking_change == true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "major"

RULE features produce minor releases
  GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
  GIVEN commit.feature == true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "minor"

RULE fixes produce patch releases
  GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
  GIVEN commit.feature == false
  GIVEN commit.fix == true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "patch"

RULE irrelevant commits produce no release
  GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
  GIVEN commit.feature == false
  GIVEN commit.fix == false
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "none"

SCENARIO breaking changes take precedence over features and fixes
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: true
    feature: true
    fix: true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "major"

SCENARIO features take precedence over fixes
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: true
    fix: true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "minor"

SCENARIO fixes produce a patch release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: true
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "patch"

SCENARIO irrelevant commits produce no release
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
    breaking_change: false
    feature: false
    fix: false
  WHEN analyze commit into release
  THEN release.level == "none"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval uses the domain behavior
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

WHEN mark known item from <items> into <result>
  FIND item in items WHERE item == "known"
    set result to item
  OTHERWISE
    set result to "missing"

SCENARIO known item is selected
GIVEN items is ["known"]
GIVEN result is "missing"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "known"

SCENARIO missing item is marked missing
GIVEN items is ["unknown"]
GIVEN result is "known"
WHEN mark known item from items into result
THEN result == "missing"

WHEN record waiting <days> into <total>
  GIVEN days is integer
  AND total is integer
  add days to total

SCENARIO waiting days are counted
GIVEN days is 5
GIVEN total is 0
WHEN record waiting days into total
THEN total == 5

RECORD Applicant
  name: text
  referral: optional<text>

WHEN classify <applicant> into <status>
  GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  IF applicant.referral is present AND applicant.referral == "trusted"
    set status to "approved"
  ELSE
    set status to "review"

SCENARIO missing referral requires review
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "review"

TYPE ReviewState = "new"

RECORD Review
  status: ReviewState

SCENARIO review begins new
GIVEN review is Review
  status: "new"
THEN review.status == "new"

WHEN approve <decision>
  set decision to "approved"

SCENARIO approval changes the decision
GIVEN decision is "new"
WHEN approve decision
THEN decision == "approved"

Should any of these states be treated as equivalent, and are there precedence rules when conflicting representations are supplied?

What rejection reason should be returned for an application from an unfunded cohort?
When both conditions apply, which rejection reason takes precedence?

What inputs and units should the scenarios use for the original price, discount percentage, tax percentage, and currency?
Should tax be calculated on the discounted price (`price × (1 − discount/100) × (1 + tax/100)`), or should a different ordering or tax basis apply?

How should the exact result be represented, including trailing zeros and currency formatting?
What behavior is required for zero, negative, or out-of-range prices and percentages?

  WHEN review item into decision

  OUTPUT decision is ReturnDecision

  THEN decision.status != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

SCENARIO approve return on day 30
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 30

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status = "approved"
  AND decision.reason = "within_window"

SCENARIO require review on day 31
  GIVEN item is ReturnRequest
    days_since_purchase: 31

  GIVEN decision is ReturnDecision
    status: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN review item into decision

  THEN decision.status = "needs_review"
  AND decision.reason = "outside_window"

PROGRAM incident triage

TYPE IncidentSeverity is "normal" | "degraded" | "critical"
TYPE IncidentPriority is "new" | "routine" | "review" | "urgent"

RECORD IncidentRequest
  severity: IncidentSeverity
  customer_outage: boolean

RECORD IncidentDecision
  priority: IncidentPriority
  reason: "new" | "normal_operations" | "degraded_service" | "customer_outage"

REQUEST triage incident
  GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest

  GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
    priority: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN triage incident into decision

  OUTPUT decision is IncidentDecision

  THEN decision.priority != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

GIVEN incident.customer_outage == true
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
AND incident.severity == "critical"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
AND incident.severity == "degraded"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "review"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

GIVEN incident.customer_outage == false
AND incident.severity == "normal"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "routine"
AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

SCENARIO customer outage takes precedence over critical severity
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: true
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "customer_outage"

SCENARIO critical severity without outage is urgent
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "critical"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "urgent"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO degraded service without outage needs review
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "degraded"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "review"
AND decision.reason == "degraded_service"

SCENARIO normal service without outage is routine
GIVEN incident is IncidentRequest
  severity: "normal"
  customer_outage: false
GIVEN decision is IncidentDecision
  priority: "new"
  reason: "new"
WHEN triage incident into decision
THEN decision.priority == "routine"
AND decision.reason == "normal_operations"

PROGRAM order fulfillment slice

RECORD FulfillmentRequest
  requested_units: integer
  available_units: integer

RECORD FulfillmentDecision
  status: "new" | "fulfilled" | "partial" | "backordered"
  reserved_units: integer
  backordered_units: integer

REQUEST fulfill order
  GIVEN order is FulfillmentRequest

  GIVEN fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision
    status: "new"
    reserved_units: 0
    backordered_units: 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  OUTPUT fulfillment is FulfillmentDecision

  THEN fulfillment.status != "new"

SCENARIO fulfill every requested unit when stock is sufficient
  GIVEN order.requested_units == 5
  GIVEN order.available_units == 5

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment.status == "fulfilled"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 5
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 0

SCENARIO partially fulfill an order when some stock exists
  GIVEN order.requested_units == 5
  GIVEN order.available_units == 2

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment.status == "partial"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 2
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 3

SCENARIO backorder every requested unit when no stock exists
  GIVEN order.requested_units == 5
  GIVEN order.available_units == 0

  WHEN fulfill order into fulfillment

  THEN fulfillment.status == "backordered"
  THEN fulfillment.reserved_units == 0
  THEN fulfillment.backordered_units == 5

PROGRAM funding eligibility slice

RECORD FundingFacts
  cohort_funded: boolean
  previously_funded: boolean
  institution_eligible: boolean

RECORD FundingDecision
  outcome: "new" | "funded" | "not_funded"
  reason: "new" | "unfunded_cohort" | "previously_funded" | "eligible" | "ineligible_institution"

REQUEST assess funding
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  OUTPUT decision is FundingDecision

  THEN decision.outcome != "new"
  AND decision.reason != "new"

WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == false
    THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    AND decision.reason = "unfunded_cohort"

WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == true
    THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
    AND decision.reason = "previously_funded"

WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == true
    THEN decision.outcome = "funded"
    AND decision.reason = "eligible"

WHEN assess facts into decision
  IF facts.cohort_funded == true
  AND facts.previously_funded == false
  AND facts.institution_eligible == false
    THEN decision.outcome = "not_funded"
    AND decision.reason = "ineligible_institution"

SCENARIO unfunded cohort outranks previous funding and eligibility
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: false
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: true

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason == "unfunded_cohort"

SCENARIO previous funding outranks institution ineligibility
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: true
    institution_eligible: false

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
  AND decision.reason == "previously_funded"

SCENARIO eligible institution is funded when earlier reasons do not apply
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: true

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "funded"
  AND decision.reason == "eligible"

SCENARIO ineligible institution is not funded when earlier reasons do not apply
  GIVEN facts is FundingFacts
    cohort_funded: true
    previously_funded: false
    institution_eligible: false

  GIVEN decision is FundingDecision
    outcome: "new"
    reason: "new"

  WHEN assess facts into decision

  THEN decision.outcome == "not_funded"
  AND decision.reason == "ineligible_institution"

PROGRAM semantic release slice

RECORD CommitFacts
  breaking_change: boolean
  feature: boolean
  fix: boolean

RECORD ReleaseDecision
  level: "new" | "major" | "minor" | "patch" | "none"

REQUEST analyze commit
  GIVEN commit is CommitFacts

  GIVEN release is ReleaseDecision
    level: "new"

  WHEN analyze commit into release

  OUTPUT release is ReleaseDecision

  THEN release.level != "new"

GIVEN commit.breaking_change == true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "major"

GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
GIVEN commit.feature == true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "minor"

GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
GIVEN commit.feature == false
GIVEN commit.fix == true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "patch"

GIVEN commit.breaking_change == false
GIVEN commit.feature == false
GIVEN commit.fix == false
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "none"

SCENARIO breaking changes take precedence over features and fixes
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: true
  feature: true
  fix: true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "major"

SCENARIO features take precedence over fixes
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: true
  fix: true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "minor"

SCENARIO fixes produce a patch release
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: false
  fix: true
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "patch"

SCENARIO irrelevant commits produce no release
GIVEN commit is CommitFacts
  breaking_change: false
  feature: false
  fix: false
WHEN analyze commit into release
THEN release.level == "none"

RECORD Applicant
  name: text
  referral: optional<text>

WHEN classify <applicant> into <status>
  GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  IF applicant.referral is present
    IF applicant.referral == "trusted"
      set status to "approved"
    ELSE
      set status to "review"
  ELSE
    set status to "review"

SCENARIO missing referral requires review
GIVEN applicant is Applicant
  name: "Ada"
GIVEN status is "new"
WHEN classify applicant into status
THEN status == "review"

TYPE ReviewState is string

RECORD Review
  status: ReviewState

SCENARIO review begins new
GIVEN review is Review
  status: "new"
THEN review.status == "new"
